notes.title: Super Blackjack Battle 2 Turbo Edition - Update 1.0.2: A.I., cross-platform multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27578004/17ee28e8a4a6cd4d857195a394ed3c7736f027ab.png[/img]

Dear Community, 

today we are excited (to say the least) and happy that we are also releasing Super Blackjack Battle 2 Turbo Edition to mobile devices [u](iOS and Android)[/u].

To celebrate and support this launch, we are also updating the current Steam version of SBJB2TE, introducing a few needed fixes and more importantly tackling one of issues you have brought to us: Improving the A.I. of the CPU opponents in the game. We hope this will make the game more enjoyable for all single player users.

Yet at the same time we are introducing the iOS vs Android vs PC cross-platform multiplayer which will allow you to compete against each other independently from the device you are using.
We have also done some minor bug fixes and tweaks not really worth mentioning here :-)

So now go, fill those server and let's find out who can become THE BEST BLACKJACK PLAYER OF THE WORLD! ;-)

Cheers,
Daniel
CEO Stage Clear Studios

notes.title: Blackjack meets Street Fighter 2 in Super Blackjack Battle 2 Turbo Edition
notes.content: It’s exciting to realise that we are living through blackjack’s greatest resurgence since the golden days of Vegas and Monaco. 21 is back, baby, with some 2017 twists. Last month, that Resident Evil 7 DLC filtered blackjack through our desire to be dismembered by cannibals. Now, a fondness for remembering things from the ’90s (do you remember the ’90s?) sees blackjack meet Street Fighter 2 in Super Blackjack Battle 2 Turbo Edition – The Card Warriors [Steam page]. Actual game. No joke. It’s blackjack with the trappings of Street Fighter, and it is now out. Look at this trailer: … [visit site to read more]
